subject: R10 transaction adapter architecture v0.1 ready for reconciliation
body: R10 initial architecture is complete. Recommendation: provider-independent Transaction Orchestrator plus narrow capability-declared adapters. Separate proposal, approval authorization, disclosure authorization, transaction, adapter operation, and calendar projection. Use stable transaction_id/operation_id with per-attempt attempt_id; post-transmit timeout becomes RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED rather than blind retry. Inbound webhooks enter an authenticated/deduplicated/version-aware inbox and should trigger authoritative read-back where possible. Calendar is downstream projection only, with stable projection identity, sync cursor, subscription expiry/renewal and optimistic-concurrency handling. Compensation is a new evidenced action, not atomic rollback. Human recovery is first-class and must use audited operations rather than direct state edits. A 30-case adapter conformance test set is included. No accepted state was modified.
